A new module that writes Parquet files, and a decimal fix in parquet-reader.

- `parquet-writer.wasm`: writes records to an Apache Parquet file (base64) that Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Spark, DuckDB, Polars and pandas read directly. Column types are inferred from the values or set per column: text, whole numbers, exact decimals up to 38 digits, dates, timestamps with or without a time zone, true/false and JSON. Choose the columns, their names and nested fields with dotted paths, and compress with Snappy, Gzip, Zstandard, LZ4 or Brotli. A value that doesn't fit its column type stops the write with the row and column named. Files are tested with pyarrow, Polars and DuckDB for every compression.
- `parquet-reader.wasm` 0.1.1: decimals with scale 0 (such as `decimal(38,0)`) are returned as `"-1"` instead of `"-1."`, and decimal text no longer depends on the parquet crate's formatter.
- `vendor/zstd-shim` now also compresses (with ruzstd), so both modules share it.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
